title: Review
description: One review of the future plan: the question the system asked, the options it offered, what the runner chose, and what happened after. A review is an option set with a 'keep as is' first option (docs/ux/review-flow.md), not a notification with a single accept button.

opened_at_day.description: Training day the review opened. One review prompt per rolling week at most (review-triggers.yaml#dwell_days and #max_prompts_per_week).

opened_by.description: User-triggered reviews are first-class: the button exists so a runner can be the one who notices.

signal_ids.description: Concrete observations, e.g. 'rhr_delta_sd:3' or 'feedback:motivation:low:streak4'. Never a device composite (metric-catalog.yaml#grade_gate).

rule_ids.description: heuristic rule ids that fired, kebab-case, so the UI can show which rule asked.

evidence_grade_max.description: Highest grade among the cited sources. D-graded evidence cannot open a review (safety-hard-stops.yaml#grade_a_or_b_only).

streak_days.description: Consecutive confirming readings; a single bad day never opens a review (noise.yaml#min_consecutive_observations).

horizon_days.description: How far into the future the options may reach. Default 14 (review-triggers.yaml#horizon_days).

freeze_days.description: Tomorrow and the day after are off limits to a review; those belong to micro-adjust (docs/adr/0005).

options.description: Option 0 is always keep_as_is. Order is fixed by the engine, never by persuasion.

label_key.description: Message-catalogue key (AGENTS rule 8); the label is translated, not generated.

diff_id.description: Null for keep_as_is: no diff, no change, no version bump.

cost_summary.description: Stated cost in the runner's terms, e.g. 'the Tuesday intervals move to Sunday and the long run shortens by 4 km'.

expires_after_day.description: An unanswered review expires rather than nagging; expiry is recorded, not deleted.

result_diff_id.description: Set only on accept. A rejection records no diff but does raise the trigger threshold for the next 30 days.

rejected_threshold_raise_days.description: After a rejection the same trigger waits longer before asking again (review-triggers.yaml#rejection_cooldown_days). The runner chose the current plan; the system does not ask twice in a week.

outcome_check_day.description: Day the review is scored against feedback, so 'did that help?' becomes an answer instead of a memory.

allowed_numbers.description: Every number the narrative may contain, supplied by the engine. A validator rejects any numeric token not in this list (AGENTS rule 2).

generated.description: False when the template fallback produced the text, which is the normal path for short strings.
